about: Real-world sizes for the reality check. Measure each object along the same dimension named here. Only compare objects at the same distance from the camera.

golf_ball.source: Rules of Golf Equipment Rules: ball diameter not less than 1.680 in (42.67 mm)

hole.source: Rules of Golf, Definitions (Hole): 4.25 in (108 mm) in diameter

flagstick.source: Industry standard 7 ft (2.13 m), 8 ft on some courses; the Rules set no height. Estimate

tee.source: Common tee lengths 2 1/8 to 3 1/4 in; Rules of Golf Equipment Rules cap tees at 4 in (101.6 mm)

driver.dimension: club length, grip end to sole
driver.source: Rules of Golf Equipment Rules: max 46 in (1168 mm) for drivers in competitions (Model Local Rule G-10); most are 43 to 45.5 in

putter.source: Standard putters 32 to 36 in, most 33 to 35 in (maker specs). Estimate

stand_bag.source: Typical stand-bag specs 33 to 37 in (maker specs, e.g. Vessel, Jordan). Estimate; check the exact model's listing

cap.dimension: width across the crown, seen from the front
cap.source: Adult cap sizes 56 to 61 cm round, about 18 to 19.5 cm across plus fabric. Estimate

cap_length.dimension: front of brim to back of crown, side view
cap_length.source: Typical curved-brim cap, 7 cm brim on a 19 to 20 cm crown. Estimate

person.source: Adult height range; South African adult men average about 1.69 m (NCD Risk Factor Collaboration). Estimate
